query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as "count!"
           FROM git_sync_synced_head h
           JOIN v2_job_completed pc ON pc.id = h.job_id
           JOIN v2_job j ON j.workspace_id = h.workspace_id
             AND j.kind IN ('dependencies', 'flowdependencies', 'appdependencies')
             AND j.created_at >= pc.started_at
             AND j.created_at <= COALESCE(h.tests_dispatched_at, now())
           JOIN v2_job_completed c ON c.id = j.id AND c.status IN ('failure', 'canceled')
           WHERE h.workspace_id = $1 AND h.repo_resource_path = $4
             AND h.branch = $3 AND h.sha = $2
             AND h.source = 'pull'
